proposals.value: Explicit wall/floor/ceiling roles in web/src/surfacePalette.ts; category-preserving selected fills; opaque linear-RGB GLB structural materials. F01 has no schema change.
proposals.rationale: Keeps batching and geometry unchanged while removing the ceiling-as-wall fallback and export color mismatch.

proposals.value: Opposite-corner wall-chart resize; edge u-only translation; explicit threshold; optional style/end/side capabilities; full reversal and bent-host policy.
proposals.rationale: Reuses full-arclength helpers without fabricating legacy door subtype or bending rigid leaves.

proposals.value: Freeze uniform legacy planes as inferred ceiling intent, unequal tops as null; explicit room height; extend necessary wall spans without shrinking them; preserve neighbor ceilings; explicit structure set/common delta.
proposals.rationale: Avoids neighbor ceiling changes from a shared wall and preserves captured height differences until an explicit correction.

proposals.value: Versioned parametric dimensions and explicit floor/wall mount; white faces/blue edges; diagrammatic nonblocking fixtures initially.
proposals.rationale: No competing editor, fake image dimensions or unimplemented obstacle-avoidance claim.

proposals.value: Independent moisture/fire records, explicit wall vertical range, physical footprint and recorded support mask; no new totals.
proposals.rationale: Prevents new damage appearing when a hole is filled, a host expands or a ceiling moves.

proposals.value: Role-qualified floor/room/ceiling references; wall ID plus positive/negative side; meters along wall and above base; fixed floor X/Z chart.
proposals.rationale: Scene triangle numbers, camera directions and undifferentiated room IDs are not durable attachment identities.

proposals.value: Snapshot/context/revision fence; frame-coalesced preview; exact final sample; one command/undo item; pre-submit cancel saves nothing; existing pending-save semantics after submit.
proposals.rationale: The current workspace commit signature needs an explicit drag-start revision fence; it cannot be assumed to supply one.

proposals.value: Compose source/result surface transforms and exact source domains; retain clipped/unresolved observations, reject unresolved rigid-fixture moves.
proposals.rationale: Existing ID mappings mark review but do not preserve physical attachment coordinates.

proposals.value: Strict feature-local versions, proposed geometry 1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 in task order; coordinated scene/profile changes only when vocabulary changes; no writable lossy downgrade.
proposals.rationale: Old schemas reject unknown fields, and current imports regenerate/compare scene geometry.

proposals.value: One shared workspace; exact host transfer/readback, actual Capacitor assets and Apple evidence, staged OS generation with separate authority; no assumed deployment.
proposals.rationale: Current source, served web and installed app have distinct revisions and acceptance gates.

open.question: Wall through-openings only, or also recesses, boundary notches and floor/ceiling voids?
open.recommendation: Start with true wall cutouts; retain other interpretations as open until explicitly resolved.

open.question: Which bounded variants of appliances and built-ins beyond the named families belong in the first catalog?
open.recommendation: Master records a proposed checklist at F04; all named families remain required. Do not treat etc. as an exhaustive source inventory.
